title: Underlying quotient section tensor comparison
statement: For fixed normalized scalar section data and normalized tensor data, the underlying quotient section tensor comparison is nonempty before its normalization equations.

proof.text: Construct the sectionwise balancing comparison and descend it through sheafification and the resolving-class equivalence. The signed total and tensor counits produce the comparison isomorphism.

theorem section_tensor_transport_normalized_barB_exists (T : Scheme.{u})
    (c : ScalarSectionData a T) (hc : ScalarSectionNormalized a T c)
    (b : TensorIso a T) (hb : TensorNormalized a T b) :
    Nonempty (tensor Λ T ⋙ c.model.T ≅
        (c.model.T.prod c.model.T) ⋙ tensor Λ' T)
